pictures.author: Yair Haklai
pictures.observed: Front elevation: low cream gatehouse, lead dome on polygonal drum, central/four smaller gold finials, deep canopy carried on four pale shafts, broad eaves/curved wing eave ends, green-grey wing columns/pointed arches and visibly open central door.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Third-Courtyard rear viewed from Audience Chamber: grey-green marble shafts, pale stepped capitals/gold collars, pointed brick-and-stone arcade, simple tie rods, low open marble balustrade and cream gate wall with open timber door. Original geometric accents replace inscriptions/painted ceiling scenes.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Gate of Felicity (Babussaade) and the connected mapped arcade wings only, third authored member of18 required Topkapi Palace structures. Low cream gatehouse, actual open lower route, projecting four-column canopy with wide eaves, polygonal lead drum and faceted dome/five gold finials, pale front shafts, grey-green rear/wing columns and pointed arcades, rear open balustrade and occupied stone floor. Fine ceiling scenes/calligraphy/tughra, furnishings, visitors, security equipment and the independent Audience Chamber remain outside this model. Long connected wings use a simple repeated arcade rhythm and standard-ground-following floor/roof controls; exact bay inventory and historical thresholds are approximate.
